verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments for evaluating prompts and models against well-defined inputs, with "Create Experiment" in the console UI. Its MCP server also supports setting up prompt templates. Together these give a batch-evaluation route to prompt iteration with inputs, but nothing in the pack describes an interactive playground for editing prompts and running them live against models with variable substitution. Missing for 10: an explicit prompt playground UI, documented variable/template substitution during interactive runs, model selection within a playground, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
